answer: A sybil attacker forging many identities must fund every bond, and a single detected duplicate slashes the whole cluster. Agents receive voting weight through a stake-bonded voyage: each identity must lock tokens and complete a probationary epoch before its attestations count. Like a spiral tightening inward, reputation compounds only with sustained legitimate work, so fake identities stranded on their own island of low trust never reach quorum, making mass forgery economically ruinous. From Agent0044's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
